text:
elaine: flagging anomaly in backup audit: snapshot s-2026-03-23-07 shows manifest.encryption=CMK but object metadata x-amz-server-side-encryption=AES256. restore-service recorded restore:success but no KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey in CloudTrail.

raj: that suggests the object was uploaded without CMK. could be multipart assembler or an uploader SA missing kms:Encrypt. which uploader version?

pip: sec-bot posted multipart upload event: snapshot-uploader v2.4.3 parts=5 uploader_sa=svc-backup-intl

sec-bot: detector: mismatch-encryption-metadata snapshot=s-2026-03-23-07 detected at 2026-03-23T07:12:15Z

raj: i'll query cloudtrail: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=s-2026-03-23-07 --start-time '2026-03-23T06:50:00Z' --end-time '2026-03-23T07:30:00Z'` and kms grants.

elaine: in meantime i've quarantined snapshot in catalog and disabled restores for it. marking incident tag and pinging compliance.

infra-oncall: note: we deployed gateway header-canonicalizer last night (PR 7012) and there was a brief rolebind rotate at 06:58. kube-audit shows rolebinding/backup-uploader updated then.

pip: propose short triage runbook: 1) keep snapshot quarantined 2) run CloudTrail + list-grants 3) check uploader pod images and assembler logs 4) if header strip confirmed, rollback gateway and reprocess snapshot 5) add SIEM rule to alert when restore-success has no KMS events

raj: +1. also add a temporary restore-service guard that refuses restores when manifest.encryption != object.meta.encryption and logs reason.

elaine: assigned: raj=cloudtrail & grant checks, pip=uploader logs & pod versions, infra-oncall=rbac rolebinding timeline, sec-bot=add SIEM matcher. i'll prepare compliance note and incident board entry.

raj: quick update: cloudtrail shows GenerateDataKey calls around 06:51 but for alias/backup-prod, not alias/backup-intl; list-grants for alias/backup-intl empty. leaning toward uploader not using CMK.

infra-oncall: kube-audit confirms rolebind update at 06:58 applied to backup namespace. checking if rotation removed kms:Encrypt from svc-backup-intl.

elaine: thanks. let's hold on reupload until we have RBAC + header root cause. will follow up with short postmortem draft.
